blocks.text: Atomic spectra ki basis (buniyad) yeh hai ke spectrometer se quantized photons ki particle nature ka evidence (saboot) milta hai. Experiment mein discharge tube, spectrometer aur diffraction grating hoti hai (Fig. 18.9): discharge tube ki roshni narrow (tang) slit aur collimator se guzar kar parallel hoti hai, grating par parti hai, aur ghoomne wali telescope se dekhi jati hai.

blocks.alt: Discharge tube ki roshni lens se narrow slit (tang jhiri) par focus hoti hai; collimator use parallel banata hai aur yeh vernier angle scale wali table ke beech diffraction grating par parti hai. Diffracted (mudi hui) rangein rotating (ghoomne wali) telescope mein jati hain jise eyepiece se dekha jata hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 18.9: diffraction grating se bana spectrum (kitab ki Figure 18.9 ke mutabiq hamari drawing).
blocks.long_description: Roshni ki har wavelength apne angle par diffract hoti (mudti) hai, is liye telescope ghumane se spectrum ki lines dark background par aik aik kar ke nazar aati hain aur un ke angles scale par parhe jate hain.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab ki shakal mein roshni ke source par 'Beam of electrons' likha hai, jo ghalat hai; text ke mutabiq source discharge tube hai, is liye hum ne 'Discharge tube' likha hai.

Spectrometer ke eyepiece se dark background (andheri jagah) par roshan lines ki series nazar aati hai. Alag alag elements ke vapours (bhaap) aisi lines ke alag alag patterns dete hain jinhein spectral series kehte hain; in se elements pehchane ja sakte hain. Aisi ek series J. J. Balmer ne 1885 mein atomic hydrogen ke spectrum mein pehchani (Fig. 18.10). Yeh electromagnetic spectrum ke visible (nazar aane wale) hisse mein hai aur is ki chaar lines hain: 656 nm (laal), 486 nm (neeli-sabz), 434 nm (neeli) aur 410 nm (violet). J. R. Rydberg ne in results ko yeh formula diya:

blocks.alt: Dark patti par hydrogen ki rangeen lines: 656 nm (red), 486 nm (blue-green), 434 nm (blue) aur 410 nm (violet), aur UV ki taraf do aur halki violet lines.
blocks.caption: Figure 18.10: atomic hydrogen ke spectrum mein Balmer series (kitab ki Figure 18.10 ke mutabiq hamari drawing).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab Balmer formula ke baen taraf h/λ chhapti hai; Rydberg formula mein 1/λ hota hai: 1/λ = R_H(1/2² − 1/n²), n = 3, 4, 5, ...

Yahan n electron ki excited energy level hai jis ki values 3, 4, 5, ... hain, aur R_H Rydberg constant hai jis ki value 1.0974 × 10⁷ m⁻¹ hai. Hydrogen ki spectral lines invisible (nazar na aane wale) ultraviolet (UV) aur infrared (IR) hisson mein bhi hain. UV mein Lyman series ki wavelengths yeh formula deta hai:

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab Eq. 18.12 ko h/λ = R_H(1/2² − 1/n²) chhapti hai, jo Balmer wala formula hi hai. Lyman series n = 1 par khatam hoti hai, is liye sahi 1/λ = R_H(1/1² − 1/n²) hai, n = 2, 3, 4, ... (kitab ki n ki values bhi isi se milti hain).

blocks.alt: Vertical (khari) patti jis mein wavelength neeche ki taraf barhti hai. Oopar Lyman series (91 se 122 nm) ki red lines, phir Balmer series (365 se 656 nm), phir 820 nm se neeche Paschen series.
blocks.caption: Aap ki maloomat ke liye: atomic hydrogen ka line spectrum; sirf Balmer series electromagnetic spectrum ke visible hisse mein hai (kitab ke box ke mutabiq hamari drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Har series ki lines aik series limit (aakhri had) ki taraf paas paas hoti jati hain: Lyman 91 nm, Balmer 365 nm aur Paschen 820 nm par. Lyman UV mein, Balmer visible roshni mein (656 se 410 nm) aur Paschen infrared mein hai.

Yahan n = 4, 5, 6, ... Is series ko Paschen series kehte hain. Energy levels Fig. 18.11 mein aur alag alag transitions (chhalangein) Fig. 18.12 mein hain.

blocks.alt: Chaar horizontal (leti hui) lines aur oopar ki taraf Energy ka arrow (teer): sab se neeche ground state E0 (n = 1), us ke oopar excited states E1 (n = 2), E2 (n = 3) aur E3 (n = 4).
blocks.caption: Figure 18.11: energy levels (kitab ki Figure 18.11 ke mutabiq hamari drawing).

blocks.alt: Hydrogen ke energy levels n = 1 se 7 aur infinity (be-had), Energy/10^-19 J axis par (not to scale, paimane ke mutabiq nahi): -21.8, -5.45, -2.42, -1.36, -0.86 aur 0.00. n = 2, 3, 4, 5 se n = 1 tak arrows Lyman series; n = 3, 4, 5, 6 se n = 2 tak Balmer series; n = 4, 5, 6, 7 se n = 3 tak Paschen series.
blocks.caption: Figure 18.12: hydrogen atom mein alag alag transitions (kitab ki Figure 18.12 ke mutabiq hamari drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Har arrow (teer) oopar wale level se neeche wale level par electron ki chhalang (transition) hai, aur photon ki energy dono levels ka farq hai. Pink arrow 656 nm aur blue arrow 486 nm wali Balmer line hai. Kitab ki figure mein Balmer ka teesra arrow dobara n = 4 se shuru hota hai; sahi n = 5 hai, is liye hum ne Balmer arrows n = 3, 4, 5, 6 se n = 2 tak banaye hain.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Yaad rakhne ka tareeqa: 1/λ = R_H(1/p² − 1/n²). Electron jis level par aa kar rukta hai woh p hai: Lyman p = 1 (UV), Balmer p = 2 (visible), Paschen p = 3 (IR). n hamesha p se bara hota hai.

Yeh equations isolated (akele) hydrogen atom mein electron ki allowed (ijazat wali) energies batati hain. n = 1 wali state (halat) ground state hai, aur n = 2, 3, 4, ... excited states hain. Atom sirf discrete (alag alag tukdon wali) amounts mein energy absorb karta hai aur kisi excited state mein chala jata hai. Excited states bohat kam der rehti hain; electron jald neeche wali level par wapas aata hai aur photon emit (kharij) karta hai. Yeh photons kai spectral lines wale emission spectrum ki shakal mein nazar aate hain.
Absorption aur emission spectra

Jab continuous spectrum wali roshni (jaise safed roshni) kam pressure wali gas se guzaar kar us ka spectrum dekhein, to kuch khaas wavelengths ki roshni missing (ghaib) milti hai aur un ki jagah dark lines hoti hain. Aise spectrum ko absorption spectrum kehte hain. Gas se guzarte waqt electrons khaas amount ki energy absorb kar ke oopar ki energy levels par chale jate hain. Sirf woh photons absorb hote hain jin ki energy bilkul utni ho jitni is chhalang ke liye chahiye. Jab yeh excited electrons neeche aate hain to unhi khaas wavelengths ke photons emit hote hain, jo emission spectrum mein nazar aate hain. Yani absorption spectrum se missing wavelengths wahi hain jo usi element ke emission spectrum mein maujood hain (Fig. 18.13).

blocks.alt: 400 se 750 nm scale par teen pattiyan: (a) continuous (lagataar) spectrum, violet se red tak poori rangon ki patti; (b) hydrogen emission spectrum, kaali patti par taqreeban 410, 434, 486 aur 656 nm par roshan lines; (c) hydrogen absorption spectrum, rangon ki patti jis mein inhi wavelengths par dark lines.
blocks.caption: Figure 18.13: aik hi element ke absorption aur emission spectrum ka relation (talluq): (a) safed roshni ka spectrum, (b) element ka emission spectrum, (c) usi element ka absorption spectrum (kitab ki Figure 18.13 ke mutabiq hamari drawing).
blocks.long_description: Gas bilkul wahi wavelengths absorb karti hai jo emit kar sakti hai, kyunke dono unhi energy levels ke darmiyan transitions (chhalangon) se aati hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ka caption hissa (b) ko absorption aur hissa (c) ko emission spectrum kehta hai, lekin panels par ulat likha hai (b emission, c absorption); panels ke label sahi hain. Kitab ke wavelength scale par bhi ghalti hai: '400 ... 650, 650, 700' chhapa hai; sahi 400 se 750 nm (har 50 nm) hai, aur hum ne yahi banaya hai.

blocks.title: Kya aap jante hain?
blocks.text: Atom ko excite karne ke liye photon ki energy do shells (levels) ki energy ke farq ke bilkul barabar honi chahiye: hf = Eₙ − Eₚ. Lekin electron agar atom se takraye to woh atom ko tab bhi excite kar sakta hai jab us ki K.E. is farq ke barabar ya zyada ho (bachi hui energy electron ke paas reh jati hai).

blocks.title: Aap ki maloomat ke liye
blocks.text: Spectra teen qisam ke hote hain: continuous spectrum (saari rangein lagataar), line spectrum (dark patti par alag alag roshan lines, jaise garam gas ke atoms) aur band spectrum (paas paas lines ke guchhe, jo molecules dete hain).

blocks.alt: Teen leti hui pattiyan. Continuous spectrum: violet se blue, green, yellow aur orange ho kar red tak bina tootay rangon ki patti. Line spectrum: kaali patti par chaar alag roshan lines, violet, blue, green aur red. Band spectrum: rangon wali patti jis par unhi chaar jagahon par dark lines hain.
blocks.caption: Aap ki maloomat ke liye: spectra ki qismein: continuous spectrum, line spectrum aur band spectrum (kitab ke box ke mutabiq hamari drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Oopar wali patti mein saari rangein aik doosre mein mili hui hain, koi gap nahi: yeh continuous (lagataar) spectrum hai. Beech wali patti kaali hai aur sirf kuch khaas wavelengths par roshan lines hain: yeh line spectrum hai, jo garam gas ke atoms dete hain. Neeche wali patti mein rangein hain lekin unhi jagahon par dark lines hain jahan line spectrum mein roshan lines thin; kitab is patti ko band spectrum kehti hai.
